{{Top}}
[[File:DH17blaster-NEGWT.png|thumb|right|250px|A [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]]]]
A '''pistol''' was a type of one-handed firearm that was generally smaller and less powerful than a [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]] or [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]]. Pistols had a lesser range than rifles, but they could be wielded in one hand. Pistols varied in size and power from the ubiquitous [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] to its cousins the larger [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] and the much smaller and easily concealed [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] pistol. Other types of pistols included the [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]], which fired bullets and similar projectiles; the [[ion pistol]], which was used to disable [[Droid/Legends|droids]]; the [[stun pistol]], designed for nonlethal crowd control; and the deadly [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]], which was able to disintegrate its targets.

Many [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] pistols had a close-range [[Stun/Legends|stun]] setting, meaning the weapon could fire stun shots instead of lethal fire. Stun shots were limited to a range of nine [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Saga Edition Core Rulebook]]''</ref>

Pistols, especially blaster pistols, were manufactured by thousands of companies and found everywhere in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in virtually every era. They were used by nearly all types of persons, including [[Noble/Legends|nobles]], [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Police officer/Legends|law enforcement agents]], [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], and anyone in need of basic firepower, personal protection, or a backup weapon.<ref name="Arms & Equipment Guide">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>
